title: Transmitter Days x/60.1?
body:
Recently I noticed a different display of values for "Transmitter Days". Before, it always showed just the days running, now it says "33/60.1". What does the "60.1" mean? I expect the transmitter to live for at least 90 days.

Version: 2020.07.13

![transmitter_days](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/60309229/97065990-b8473080-15b1-11eb-9aad-249f4f2ccfec.jpg)

comments.body: Did the value after the slash decreases while the value before the slash increases? My guess is that it shows the remaining days.

I'm on exactly the same xDrip+ version: 2020.07.13 and also running an 8J tx with exactly the same firmware.
==> only showing a single value here, obviously the number of days the tx is already in operation.

The value after the slash stays the same. Or it stopped decreasing, if showing the remaining days is its purpose.
The first value is counting correctly: now "34/60.1". I’m pretty sure there was only the single value at start.

To add the latest circumstances:
I did a restart of the previous sensor after ten days, with a rechargeable 81xxx transmitter for testing purpose. After five days I stopped it and started a new sensor, again with the 8J transmitter. Maybe switching the transmitters caused this? Unfortunately I cant’t remember when the display changed; _while_ using the 81 or _after_ going back to the 8J.

Update:
Obviously these are remnants from the 81 tx change. After switching to this tx again, xDrip says "69/69/69.0".
